user_authorized_basis.door_side: one side; route/platform compatibility must be checked
user_authorized_basis.ethos: Simple locally maintainable equipment, low whole-life cost, comfortable seating and useful passenger throughput
user_authorized_basis.ordinary_guideway: Concrete beam with passive steel facings; all permanent magnets and suspension control coils onboard

component_design_basis.seating: Passing sandwich construction with counted paired and single-seat derivatives at retained-post clearances; exact fitted inventory governs
component_design_basis.doors: Smallest passing 60mm-core two-leaf fixture; retain 41kg operator reference and unresolved depth compatibility
component_design_basis.glazing: Retained laminated-glass assembly reference; rail polycarbonate remains a separate unqualified option
component_design_basis.roof: Revised continuous aluminium-skin H60 sandwich on retained ribs; exact skin/core/datum shims in the candidate. Original added-crossrail proposal is retained as a rejected interference control.
component_design_basis.frame: 6082 six-cell 40kN module-reaction frame; complete body and load paths still require verification
component_design_basis.magnetics: Exact retained 12L differential N35UH support assembly; no unsupported force/current interpolation
component_design_basis.HVAC: Retain five identified package references until actual 50C capacity and power are known
component_design_basis.assembly_revision_authority: Counted revisions needed to solve matched assembly conflicts are allowed; retain failed geometry, rerun necessary load/clearance screens and create new body/candidate identities.

campaign.revision_rule: This is an explicit 120-second comfort-service proposal. Historical city plans and physical crowd loads are preserved. Complete installed mass, stable suspension, guaranteed braking, fault protection and supplier/site evidence remain gates.
campaign.service_variant_scope: Up to144 primary speed/spacing/dwell/drag cases, with up to3 shared winding arrangements per case; all actual comparison counts and failures retained.
